{"thought": "order_ts 是 TEXT 欄位，先確認日期格式，再計算 2025 年 1 月的有效訂單數（status IN (1,2,3)，以 order_id 去重）。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT order_ts, status FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5", "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders_2025_01 FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-02-01'"]}}
